hrr-01-c2.text: Titus Kennedy (2019). The Land of the Shasu (Nomads) of yhwA at Soleb. Dotawo: A Journal of Nubian Studies 6, pp. 175-192.
hrr-01-c2.quote: These even earlier inscriptions from the reign of Amenhotep III also referred to the “land of the nomads of yhwA.”
hrr-01-c2.claim: Egyptian lists from Amenhotep III's temple at Soleb (14th century BCE) name a "land of the Shasu of yhw"

hrr-04-c1.text: Rebecca Denova (2022). The Divinity of Jesus. World History Encyclopedia.
hrr-04-c1.quote: The letters of Paul date from the 50s to the 60s and are our first historical writings on Jesus of Nazareth
hrr-04-c1.claim: The earliest Christian writings are the letters of Paul, a former Pharisee who wrote between about 50 and 60 CE.
